_doc: Maintenance requests executed by .github/workflows/ops.yml when this file changes on main. Each request runs once; keep the list as a log.

close_issues.comment: Cause: pace.py imported pandas in the stdlib-only snapshot job (runaway loop 2026-09-30, no CND requests). Fixed in c87ffab; chain bugs fixed in 1c29091 and 7874b1f. Closing.

irregular_step = the source occasionally skips one minute label in the trend (e.g. 08:20 -> 08:22). Harmless: other fetches hold the minute and the gap report shows 100% coverage. Now logged without alerting (BENIGN_DRIFT_KINDS). Closing.
